name: WHITE ALBUM
source: You play a university student named Fuji Touya. Your long-term girlfriend, Morikawa Yuki, is starting to become a very popular idol singer. Unfortunately, her popularity begins to pull the two of you apart; you must either try to maintain your relationship with her or find someone else.
translation: 你扮演一名名叫藤井冬弥的大学生。你的长期女友森川由绮正在成为一名非常受欢迎的偶像歌手。不幸的是，她的人气开始将你们两人拉开距离；你必须要么努力维持与她的关系，要么另寻他人。
